customManagers.description: Every biome.json names the Biome release it was written for in its $schema URL, and scripts/check-skeleton-toolchain.mjs holds each skeleton's URL, and each manifest's @biomejs/biome pin, to the release library/config/biome.base.json names. The npm manager moves the pins and nothing moves the URLs, so a Biome update fails that gate until the URLs are edited by hand. Tracked as @biomejs/biome, the URLs move in the same update, and on the same branch, as the pins.
